title: UPS announces executive changes and new global operating model
summary:
UPS has announced that Kate Gutmann, executive vice president and president, International, Healthcare and Supply Chain Solutions, will retire for personal family reasons, effective September 1. She will continue as a strategic advisor through March 2027.

Gutmann has spent nearly 37 years at UPS, and the company said she played a central role over the last six years in advancing its healthcare logistics business and guiding its international operations through recent changes in US trade policy, while delivering strong operating margins across her three business units.

title: Brussels retreats on supply-chain rules – but logistics won’t escape the compliance machine
summary:
For years, European companies have been preparing for a new era of supply-chain regulation.
Consultants were hired, sustainability departments expanded and suppliers received increasingly detailed questionnaires. Freight forwarders, carriers and warehouse operators discovered that moving cargo was no longer enough. They also needed to explain how it was moved, by whom, under which conditions and, increasingly, with what environmental impact.
